title: Insha za Kubuni (Theme 9: Matumizi ya vifaa vya kidijitali katika mawasiliano)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 7 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child plans insha ya kubuni before writing: the parts in order, then one idea at a time, then checks it against the type.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a correct sentence with a capital letter and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a model text with its parts labelled
steps: Read the title and say the type.
Check against the checklist and correct.
contexts: a letter or story for a family member

board.say: Insha hii ni ya aina gani, na itakuwa na sehemu zipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the three-box plan for "Ujumbe Uliobadilisha Maisha Yangu".

misconceptions.ask: Wazo kuu la aya hii ni lipi?
misconceptions.repair: Kila aya ikuze wazo moja kuu.
Dumisha nafsi na mtazamo mmoja wa msimulizi.
Onyesha hisia kwa vitendo na picha, si kwa neno moja tu.

listen_for: tuliripoti kwa polisi, tuligundua ni utapeli, nilimwonyesha mama, nilipokea ujum
misconceptions.repair: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya kubuni kuhusu "Ujumbe Uliobadilisha Maisha Yangu"?
checks.answer: Moyo wangu ulidunda kama ngoma nilipousoma ujumbe ule.

checks.question: Insha ya kubuni ina sehemu zipi?
